tests.description: Checks passive need decay and the stat effects of each completed pet-care action.
tests.name: Virtual pet stats change
source: harness.assert(typeof after === 'number' && after > before, `${action} increases ${stat} after the action completes (before ${before}, after ${after})`);

tests.description: Checks that all five action icons follow the pointer, trigger the matching pet action on drop, and return to their original positions; also checks a missed drop.
tests.name: Drag actions to virtual pet
source: harness.assert(Math.hypot(dragged.centerX - pet.centerX, dragged.centerY - pet.centerY) < 60, `${name} follows the pointer onto the pet`);
harness.assert(Math.hypot(returned.x - start.x, returned.y - start.y) < 2, `${name} returns to its starting position after drop`);
harness.assert(current === name, `${name} drop starts the matching pet action (got ${current})`);
harness.assert(Math.hypot(returned.x - icon.x, returned.y - icon.y) < 2, 'A missed drop also returns the icon to its starting position');
harness.assert(current === 'Idle', `A missed drop does not start an action (got ${current})`);

- Object slowly rocking back and forth (like a ship)
